name: Your Name or Handle
contact: optional: URL, NIP-05, or handle for disclosure coordination

keys.ssh_key: ssh-ed25519 AAAA... (contents of your ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub, key type + base64 only)

keys.public_key:
-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----
... armored public key ...
-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----

note: Copy this to auditors/<your-slug>.json, keep ONLY the key type(s) you will actually sign with, and delete this note. Sign with:  nostr -> `osc sign <f> --nsec nsec1...` ;  ssh -> `osc sign <f> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 --principal you@example.com` ;  pgp -> `osc sign <f> --pgp [--gpg-key <keyid>]`. `type` is optional (inferred from the fields). List multiple entries for rotation or to support more than one scheme. Publish the same key(s) somewhere public (Nostr profile / NIP-05, github.com/<user>.keys, a keyserver) so others can cross-check your identity out of band.
